answer.summary: Application context fails to start in every API test shard with NoSuchMethodError on DefaultMeterObservationHandler.builder, a micrometer/Spring Boot classpath mismatch. The change is a Renovate bump of spring-boot-starter-parent to 4.x in pom.xml, so the dependency upgrade is the likely cause. The error is deterministic and will repeat on re-run. The 10 listed tests are a subset: the run reports 543 errors across 1045 tests.

evidence.quote: Correct the classpath of your application so that it contains compatible versions of the classes org.springframework.boot.micrometer.metrics.autoconfigure.MetricsAutoConfiguration and io.micrometer.core.instrument.observation.DefaultMeterObservationHandler
